thread:
Evan Li: Quick heads up - Prospect wants signed orderform + countersigned MSA before we spin up POC. They insist invoices to their EU subsidiary, BYOK/HSM attestation, and net45. Can legal/finance accept a delegated signer for the EU entity? :thinking:

Marta Novak: We can support Private/Dedicated for the POC. BYOK/HSM only on Private. For delegation we need proof of authority (POA/board resolution) and matching registry entry.

Ibrahim Saleh: Finance: net45 OK provided we get a formal PO and pass credit review. If procurement is slow, offer proforma/prepay for early provisioning. Also need VAT number for invoicing.

Evan Li: Uploaded files: https://drive.redwood.example/Orion_Orderform_v5.pdf and Orion_MSA_redline.docx

Zoe Park: Skimming the redline. They added: "customer-controlled HSM with quarterly attestation and prohibition on key export." Our counter: customer HSM allowed only for Private deployments, require independent attestation within 30 days of go-live, and BYOK/export needs security exception. I'll draft changes.

FinanceBot: Note from finance: If invoices go to Orion EU Holdings (VAT EU-OR-3344) we will accept but will not provision until PO is uploaded or prepay received. Net45 will start from invoice date after PO is validated.

Ibrahim Saleh: Can we accept a scanned delegation letter or do we require notarized POA? Marta?

Marta Novak: For EU subsidiaries a signed delegation + registry lookup is usually sufficient. If signer is not on registry we ask for notarized POA or board resolution. Translated English copy recommended.

Evan Li: Customer asked for 99.99% SLA with credits. Ops impact?

Zoe Park: 4 nines is heavy. We can offer 99.95% for Dedicated with capped credits. 99.99% requires multi-region Dedicated, active failover and an SLA uplift fee plus a 12-month reserved commitment. Ops/product signoff required.

Ibrahim Saleh: Suggest offering conditional 99.99% as a paid add-on tied to a 12-month commit to limit exposure. Finance OK with that approach.

docu_sign_bot: Envelope created for orderform/MSA. Recipients: Marta Novak, Evan Li, billing_contact. Envelope ID: env_orion_b7c2.

Evan Li: Customer wants countersign by EOD Friday. Marta - legal doable?

Marta Novak: Tight but doable if we finalize KMS and SLA counters by tomorrow AM. I'll post tracked changes and route back to DocuSign. Evan please request delegation docs from customer and VAT info.

FinanceBot: Once signed, billing can issue proforma if customer elects prepay. Otherwise account will be on credit hold until PO is received.

Evan Li: Thanks team. Action items: Marta to upload counters, Ibrahim to confirm proforma flow, Zoe to estimate ops uplift for 99.99%, Evan to request delegation docs and VAT. :thumbsup:
